info.name: PayJoy Partner API V2 Carts Reconciliation API

params.name: startTime
params.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds indicating the start of the time range.

params.name: endTime
params.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds indicating the end of the time range

items.docs: Retrieves a list of transactions within a specified time range. **Note**: startTime and endTime query parameters are required to define the period.
